title: SeasonCalendar
description: How the year turns in the region: on which days leaves come out, colour and fall, and the ground greens and withers. Lives in defs/seasons.json. Between two entries everything blends evenly; after the last entry the year wraps round to the first.

day.description: Day of the year, 1 for 1 January. Entries go in order.

foliage.description: Which of each species' season colours its foliage has on this day.

leaves.description: How much of a deciduous tree's crown is in leaf, 0 bare to 1 full.

ground.description: The colour of vegetated ground: green summer, coloured autumn, or withered dormant (late autumn to spring).
